key_insight: QCap combines a graph neural network with a coarse physics prior to predict superconducting-device capacitance matrices rapidly and accurately.
engineering_relevance: Fast capacitance extraction can accelerate superconducting-circuit design, with a 9-qubit layout evaluated in 12 seconds on a laptop versus 19.9 hours in Ansys Q3D.
method: Embed planar device layouts into a universal graph representation.
Compute a coarse capacitance prior using a fast method-of-moments simulation.
Train a graph neural network to correct the physics prior.
evidence_signal: Against Q3D, QCap achieved 0.177% median error on 4,009 held-out designs and below 1% error on unseen component families; a 100-qubit, 781-conductor layout ran in 3.4 minutes on a laptop.
watch_item: The 100-qubit example was too large for reference simulation, so its runtime demonstrates scale but not independently verified accuracy.
paper_title: QCap: a physics-corrected graph neural network for the capacitance matrix of any planar superconducting device layout
